task: Bilingual interface and locale-aware brand alignment, preserving form auto-save and draft recovery
scope: Per-input autosave and draft recovery for operational forms
Assessment IndexedDB drafts with per-input persistence
Credential and binary-file exclusion from browser drafts
Autosave status feedback and cleanup after successful submit
Shared phone normalization/validation and editable phone-field enforcement
Persian and English localization across public authentication, registration, app shell, dashboards, operational pages and admin views
Locale-specific Persian and English NIVASafe wordmarks with RTL/LTR alignment
decisions: Operational form drafts are scoped by authenticated user and organization.
Every input and change event persists immediately to browser storage; IndexedDB is used for assessment drafts and storage fallback.
Passwords, recovery tokens and file inputs are never persisted in drafts.
Successful submissions clear the corresponding draft while failed submissions retain it for recovery.
Phone values remain canonical local Iranian mobile numbers matching ^09\d{9}$; the backend is authoritative.
Locale is persisted locally for continuity, applied to the document language and direction, and synchronized to the authenticated profile when changed.
